armFairness.sameEventsDurationsResources: eventTape, durationTicks, demand and initial capacities identical across arms

armFairness.replayModel: non-preemptive, dependency-free, capacities exclusively from the common event tape (absolute values), reductions affect future admissions only, per-tick order tape -> completions -> admissions

repetitions.note: author-declared constants; parent may re-pin different counts before execution; no CLI/env flag exists to change them

expectedCounters.role: analytic expectations: independently recomputed in the driver (E=3A-4B-1, I=floor(N/64), B=ceil(A/64), kind splits A / A-3B / A-2B / B-1, SCC=B+I, last block 25/52, prepared=ceil(N/4)) and asserted against the generated structure; frozen anchors 2890/28915 are a cross-check ONLY and are NEVER presented as observations
